comparison: Overlap holds twenty terminal complete checks. Width improves mass TV .27759 to .01172 and full covariance error9.68690 to2.13772, still above.85; complete suffix0. Rare/aniso broad allocation improves while HQ/tails worsen. Intensity clean count drops19 to9 of32 and blobs saturate toward blank finite sigmoid outputs. All three native precision/shape gates remain FAIL. One global recipe is evaluated on the full unchanged seed-0 panel; no per-task recipe mixing.
conclusion: 5/15 PASS: overlap is the sole new sustained repair, and all four regression controls retain PASS. Ten original failing tasks remain FAIL. Global quartic transport does not solve its intended full-tail or image-fidelity problem.
